verdict.rationale: The GST portal publishes help material before you start: registration Part A and Part B videos, a step-by-step registration manual, temporary User ID generation, DSC versus EVC verification, DSC registration, and first-time login. These cover the account, credential, and identity-proofing walls that stand before filing. The evidence is only module titles and links, though, with no consolidated pre-start checklist mapping every step between a founder and filing. Missing for 10: a single published end-to-end checklist of the account, credential, and identity-proofing prerequisites for filing; substantive doc content beyond titles; independent or hands-on corroboration that no steps surface mid-flow.
